title: Beyond the Ring: Why We Invested in Ultrahuman
summary: A look at Qualcomm Ventures investments and accomplishments in 2025.
body_markdown:
SHARE
NOW


At Qualcomm Ventures, we invest behind the technology shifts that will define the future. We partner with founders creating new categories through the convergence of hardware, software, and AI, turning breakthrough technologies into products and experiences that reshape industries.[Our investment](https://techcrunch.com/2026/09/03/qualcomm-backs-ultrahuman-in-70m-round-on-bet-to-turn-smart-rings-into-computers/) in Ultrahuman reflects our belief that personalized health is emerging as one of the most important consumer technology opportunities of the coming decade.


##
Why Ultrahuman


Healthcare is shifting from reactive care to proactive health optimization. Ultrahuman’s founders recognized this trend early and built a platform focused on helping users better understand and improve their health through continuous physiological insights.


What impressed us most was not just the vision, but the team’s ability to execute across hardware, software, AI, manufacturing, and consumer experience—capabilities rarely found in a single company.


##
The Shift from Fitness Tracking to Health Intelligence


Most wearables track activity. Ultrahuman goes a step further by helping users understand how sleep, nutrition, stress, and recovery affect their overall health.


By combining continuous monitoring with actionable insights, the company is helping move the industry from passive tracking toward personalized health intelligence.


##
Building the Next Generation of Wearable Intelligence


We believe smart rings represent one of the most compelling wearable form factors. They are comfortable, unobtrusive, and naturally suited for continuous monitoring.


With the Ultrahuman Ring AIR, the company has established itself as a leader in a fast-growing category, delivering health-related insights through a product users can seamlessly incorporate into their daily lives. More recently, **Ring Pro** demonstrates Ultrahuman’s continued product innovation through significantly extended battery life, helping address one of the key challenges of continuous wearable usage.


Beyond hardware, Ultrahuman is also building an increasingly intelligent software layer. **Jade AI** reflects the company’s vision of transforming complex physiological signals into personalized insights and health recommendations, making health data more accessible and useful for everyday users.


Together, these innovations highlight Ultrahuman’s strength at the intersection of hardware, AI, and personalized health—a combination we believe will define the next generation of consumer wearables.


##
Beyond Health: New Interfaces for Human Computing


While Ultrahuman’s initial success has been driven by health, we believe the underlying technologies have broader relevance.


As computing becomes more contextual, personalized, and AI-native, wearable devices are evolving from passive sensors into intelligent companions. Continuous sensing, edge AI, and low-power computing are enabling devices to better understand user intent, context, and behavior in real time.


Over time, we believe these capabilities could unlock entirely new interaction models across personal computing, spatial computing, and connected device ecosystems. Companies building deep expertise across sensors, AI, and hardware will be well positioned as these experiences emerge.


##
What Excited Us Most


Our investment thesis is centered around platforms that combine intelligent computing with meaningful real-world applications.


Ultrahuman exemplifies the type of company we seek to back: one that applies advances in hardware, AI, and sensing to solve a significant consumer need. Just as importantly, the company has demonstrated an ability to build globally competitive products from India for users around the world.


##
Looking Ahead


We believe the future of healthcare will be increasingly personalized, preventive, and driven by continuous intelligence.


But we also believe that the devices consumers wear every day are likely to become increasingly important computing platforms in their own right. The same advances in sensing, AI, and low-power processing that enable personalized health insights today may eventually enable richer, more intuitive ways for people to interact with technology tomorrow.


Ultrahuman is building foundational capabilities at this intersection of health, intelligence, and wearables. By transforming continuous physiological data into meaningful insights while developing expertise in next-generation wearable platforms, the company is positioning itself for opportunities that extend well beyond traditional health tracking.


We are excited to support Ultrahuman as they continue to push the boundaries of personalized health and help shape the future of wearable intelligence.
